materials.title: Rain Stick Workshop 014
materials.text: We make rain sticks with paper tubes. Put dry beans inside. Cover one end before you add beans. Leave space so the beans can move. Tape the second end shut before turning the tube over. Use paper scraps to decorate it. Do not use wet paint today.

questions.prompt: A friend adds beans before covering either end. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A先封一端防漏；B翻开筒会漏且非顺序；C要求干豆无加水。

questions.prompt: A friend fills the tube right to the top. You say, "____"
options: Leave space for the beans to move.
Put the tube in a cup of water.
questions.explanation: B留活动空间；A塞更多相反；C浸水非步骤。

questions.prompt: A friend turns the tube before sealing the second end. You say, "____"
options: Tape the second end shut first.
questions.explanation: C翻前封另一端；A先摇、B全开都会违封口步骤。

questions.prompt: A friend wants a wet paint pot for decoration. You say, "____"
options: Use wet paint all over it.
Put the beans in the paint.
questions.explanation: A今日纸屑装饰禁湿漆；B用湿漆违要求；C豆漆混非装饰方案。

questions.prompt: A friend asks what goes inside. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B干豆指定填料；A湿沙、C冰块不是本课材料。

materials.title: Lunch Tray Return 014
materials.text: After lunch, take your cup off the tray first. Cups go in the round tub. Put spoons in the small tray. Empty food scraps into the brown bin. Then stack the empty food tray on the low shelf. Carry one tray at a time. Leave glass cups for an adult.

questions.prompt: A friend puts a cup into the spoon tray. You say, "____"
options: Put the cup in the brown bin.
Put the cup in the round tub.
Put the spoon in the cup and leave.
questions.explanation: B杯入圆盆；A棕桶放食物残渣；C未按杯勺分流。

questions.prompt: A friend stacks a tray with food still on it. You say, "____"
options: Put the food in the round tub.
Empty the food into the brown bin first.
questions.explanation: C先残渣入棕桶再叠空盘；A未清先叠；B圆盆收杯非食物。

questions.prompt: A friend carries three food trays together. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A一次一盘；B五盘更多违规则；C头顶非要求。

questions.prompt: A friend asks where empty food trays go. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B空托盘低架；A勺盘、C杯盆用途不同。

questions.prompt: A friend starts to collect glass cups. You say, "____"
options: Carry them in a food tray stack.
Put them in the food bin.
Leave the glass cups for an adult.
questions.explanation: C玻璃杯成人处理；A叠搬、B食物桶均不合例外规则。

materials.title: Ice Cube Bowls 014
materials.text: Mum gives us two ice cubes of the same size. We put one in a metal bowl and one in a plastic bowl. Both bowls stand on the kitchen table. We look after five minutes. The cube in the metal bowl is smaller. We draw both cubes. My brother wants to add warm water, but Mum says to keep both bowls dry for this test.

questions.prompt: The ice cubes start at the same size.
questions.explanation: A正确：same size明确起始条件；B否认相同。

questions.prompt: One bowl stands outside in the garden.
questions.explanation: B正确：both on kitchen table；A把一碗移到园外。

questions.prompt: The class checks the cubes after an hour.
questions.explanation: B正确：we look after five minutes，非一小时；A时间不符且材料不是班级。

questions.prompt: The ice cube in the metal bowl looks smaller after five minutes.
questions.explanation: A正确：metal bowl cube smaller；B否认观察结果。

questions.prompt: Mum lets the brother add warm water during this test.
questions.explanation: B正确：母亲要求本次两碗保持干；A把未获同意提议当许可。

materials.title: Balloon Loose Ribbon 014
materials.text: At a party, I tie my balloon to a chair. Its ribbon comes loose when the chair moves. The balloon flies into a small tree. I want to climb up, but Dad says no. He reaches it with a long stick. The balloon is safe, but it is not as round as before. I draw a face on it and leave it indoors for the rest of the party.

questions.prompt: The writer first ties the balloon to a chair.
questions.explanation: A正确：tie balloon to chair；B否认最初固定方式。

questions.prompt: The balloon flies away because the ribbon comes loose.
questions.explanation: A正确：ribbon loose后飞到树上；B否认因果。

questions.prompt: Dad lets the writer climb the tree.
questions.explanation: B正确：Dad says no；A把阻止说成允许。

questions.prompt: Dad gets the balloon with a long stick.
questions.explanation: A正确：reaches with long stick；B否认方法。

questions.prompt: The writer leaves the balloon outside for the rest of the party.
questions.explanation: B正确：leave it indoors；A内外颠倒。

materials.title: Bell On Cat Toy 014
materials.text: Our cat likes a cloth mouse. There is a little bell inside it. One day, the cat bites a hole in the cloth. Mum sees the bell through the hole and takes the toy away. She makes a new mouse with no bell. The old bell goes into her sewing box, where the cat cannot reach it. The cat likes the new mouse too.

questions.prompt: The cat’s old mouse is made of cloth.
questions.explanation: A正确：cloth mouse；B否认材质。

questions.prompt: The bell is outside the old toy from the beginning.
questions.explanation: B正确：初始inside，破洞后可见；A把后续可见当一开始外置。

questions.prompt: Mum takes the damaged toy away.
questions.explanation: A正确：sees bell through hole and takes away；B否认动作。

questions.prompt: The new toy has two bells.
questions.explanation: B正确：new mouse with no bell；A捏造两铃。

questions.prompt: The old bell is kept where the cat cannot reach it.
questions.explanation: A正确：sewing box cat cannot reach；B否认存放限制。

materials.title: Craft Invitation Time 014
materials.text: Our class makes cards for a craft show. The first card says, "Come on Saturday in the art room." It has no time. Lina says her grandma may arrive too early or too late. We add "Open from 2:00 to 4:00 in the afternoon." Then we notice that the school gate is on a different street from the art room. We add a small written direction: "Use the north gate and follow the blue arrows." Before printing more cards, two pupils read the whole card and check every detail with the teacher.

questions.prompt: What important detail is missing from the first card?
questions.explanation: C有周六和美术室但无时间；A地点已给；B星期已给。

questions.prompt: Who might arrive at the wrong time?
options: Nobody, because the time is printed.
questions.explanation: A提出祖母可能早晚到；B司机未提；C首卡没印时间。

questions.prompt: How long is the craft show open?
questions.explanation: B下午2至4共两小时；A四、C一均不符。

questions.prompt: Which gate should visitors use?
questions.explanation: C北门后蓝箭头；A南门、B闭门无依据。

questions.prompt: What happens before more cards are printed?
options: Two pupils check all details with the teacher.
questions.explanation: A印前双人通读核教师；B不删时间；C祖母不承担印制。

materials.title: Piano Key Stickers 014
materials.text: For beginners, the music teacher puts removable letter stickers on some piano keys. The stickers are small and do not cover the spaces between keys. One pupil wants to use strong glue so they stay longer. The teacher says the keys must be easy to clean. She uses removable stickers instead. After the short course, the class takes the stickers off carefully. They keep a paper keyboard chart beside the piano for pupils who still need a reminder.

questions.prompt: Every key is completely covered by a large sticker.
questions.explanation: B正确：some keys，小贴且不盖键缝；A扩大成全部完全盖大贴。

questions.prompt: One pupil suggests strong glue.
questions.explanation: A正确：wants strong glue；B否认建议。

questions.prompt: The teacher chooses removable stickers to keep cleaning easy.
questions.explanation: A正确：must easy clean，uses removable；B否认选择理由。

questions.prompt: The stickers stay on forever after the course.
questions.explanation: B正确：课后carefully take off；A永久保留相反。

questions.prompt: A paper chart remains for pupils needing help.
questions.explanation: A正确：keep paper keyboard chart；B否认替代提醒。

materials.title: Playground Water Count 014
materials.text: The eco club put a counter beside the playground water tap. Each time a pupil filled a bottle, a helper pressed the button once. At the end of the week, the counter showed 180. The club first planned a poster saying, "We saved 180 plastic bottles." A teacher asked how they knew every refill replaced a new plastic bottle. Some pupils had always brought reusable bottles, and a few filled the same bottle twice in one day. The club changed the poster to "180 bottle refills recorded." They still wanted to encourage refilling, but they chose a statement that matched what they had actually counted.

questions.prompt: The counter recorded each bottle refill.
questions.explanation: A正确：每装一瓶按一次；B否认统计单位。

questions.prompt: The number 180 proved that 180 different pupils used the tap.
questions.explanation: B正确：同瓶同人可多次，计的是refills；A把次数当不同人数。

questions.prompt: The teacher questioned the claim about plastic bottles saved.
questions.explanation: A正确：问如何知每次替代新塑料瓶；B否认质疑。

questions.prompt: The club removed all encouragement to refill bottles.
questions.explanation: B正确：still wanted encourage；A把谨慎改表述说成放弃鼓励。

questions.prompt: The final poster used the measure the club had directly counted.
questions.explanation: A正确：改称180 refills对应按钮计数；B否认最终证据匹配。

units.title: 图书馆分区重开的公告

materials.title: Library Reopening Phases 014
materials.text:
Library reopening notice
From Monday, the ground-floor reading room will reopen after repairs. The upstairs shelves remain closed until the safety check is complete. Books already requested from upstairs can be collected at the ground-floor desk if you receive a collection message. Please do not go upstairs to look for them. The return slot beside the main door is available all day. Study tables may be used without booking, but the small group room must be reserved. Opening hours are 10:00–17:00 this week, one hour shorter than usual. We will post another notice when the whole library is ready.

questions.prompt: Which area reopens on Monday?
questions.explanation: B一楼阅览室重开；A楼上仍闭；C屋顶无开放信息；D不是全馆。

questions.prompt: How may a reader collect a requested upstairs book?
options: Use the ground-floor desk after a collection message.
Take any book from a repair worker.
questions.explanation: C收取书通知后一楼台领；A明禁上楼；B屋顶、D工人私取无据。

questions.prompt: What is available all day?
questions.explanation: A门旁还书槽全天；B需预约且无全天；C仍闭；D导览未提供。

questions.prompt: Which space requires a reservation?
questions.explanation: D小组室须约；A学习桌不用约；B槽、C门不属预约空间。

questions.prompt: What are this week’s opening hours?
questions.explanation: B本周10至17；A/C均多一小时；D无通宵。

materials.title: Library Headset Covers 014
materials.text:
Choose from the bank and complete every gap. Use each word once. Bank: A. beside B. record C. clean D. before E. replace
The language corner has a box of fresh headset covers ____1____ the computer. Helpers check each pair ____2____ a new pupil uses it. They ____3____ any torn cover with a fresh one. Pupils must keep their hands ____4____ when fitting the covers. At closing time, helpers ____5____ how many new covers were used, so the teacher knows when to order more.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A beside表电脑旁；B record记录、E replace更换是动作；C clean形容词，D before时间连接词均不表此处位置。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: D before在下一人用前检查；A beside不接完整时间句；B record、C clean、E replace均不能连接该句表先后。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: E replace...with以新换破；B record记录不合with fresh one更替结构；A beside、C clean、D before均不表该谓语动作。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: C clean作keep hands表语，手保持干净；A beside、D before缺所需结构；B record和E replace均不描述手的状态。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: B record记录用量供补货；E replace不能接how many从句表达记录；A beside、C clean、D before均不作所需统计谓语。

units.title: 校门交通观察中的改道

materials.title: School Gate Traffic Route 014
materials.text:
The safety club observed traffic outside school for one week. It counted bicycles, cars and delivery vans from 7:30 to 8:00 each morning. On Thursday, the number of cars fell sharply. A pupil thought the school’s new walking poster had worked at once. Another member checked the town noticeboard and found that roadworks had diverted cars away from the gate that day.
The club added the diversion to its log. It did not remove Thursday’s figures, but it did not compare them with other days as if the conditions were unchanged. For the poster’s longer-term effect, members planned another observation after the road reopened. They also asked families whether their usual journey had changed. The report separated counted traffic from reported travel choices. The teacher praised the group for looking for another explanation before announcing success.

questions.prompt: What did the club count each morning?
options: All vehicles in the whole town.
questions.explanation: B三类校外交通；A非海报阅读者；C范围非全城；D不限教师自行车。

questions.prompt: What alternative explanation was found for Thursday’s fewer cars?
options: The counting period lasted one minute.
questions.explanation: C施工改道；A永久关校、B全卖车、D一分钟均无据。

questions.prompt: How did the club handle Thursday’s data?
options: Keep it with a note about the changed conditions.
Multiply it until it matched Monday.
Call it proof of the poster’s effect.
questions.explanation: A留数加改道说明；B未删除；C未造数据；D不当单独证明。

questions.prompt: When was another observation planned?
questions.explanation: D道路重开后复观；A相反；B午夜不符早高峰；C已有计划。

questions.prompt: Why were counted traffic and family reports separated?
options: They were different kinds of evidence.
Reports could replace every observation automatically.
questions.explanation: B观察数与自述选择为不同证据；A均未编造；C无禁步行；D未自动互替。

units.title: 班级故事册的署名讨论

materials.title: Group Story Credit 014
materials.text:
Four pupils made a class storybook. Mei wrote the first version, Omar changed the ending, Liv drew the pictures, and Ben checked spelling and arranged the pages. The cover first named only Mei because she had written the longest part. Ben said that word count did not show every kind of work.
The group discussed the contributions before printing. They kept Mei’s role as first writer but added a page naming each pupil’s work. They also checked with a younger pupil whose spoken idea had inspired one scene. With his permission, they thanked him without claiming he had written the whole story. The final book did not pretend that every contribution was identical. It made the different roles visible and avoided giving credit only to the work that was easiest to count.

questions.prompt: Mei wrote the first version of the story.
questions.explanation: A正确：首段明确Mei初稿；B否认角色。

questions.prompt: Ben only drew pictures and did no other work.
questions.explanation: B正确：Ben校拼写排版，Liv画图；A角色交换且否认实际工作。

questions.prompt: The first cover credited only the pupil with the longest written part.
questions.explanation: A正确：只Mei因写最多；B否认初稿署名依据。

questions.prompt: The final book claimed that everyone had done exactly the same work.
questions.explanation: B正确：明确different roles而非identical；A把平等看见贡献误作相同任务。

questions.prompt: The younger pupil was thanked with permission for an idea that inspired a scene.
questions.explanation: A正确：问许可后感谢启发场景想法；B否认来源与许可。
